evals.name: Pre-Signed URL Upload Architecture — File Bytes Bypass Backend
evals.prompt: Implement a secure file upload endpoint that prevents file bytes from being buffered by the application server.
evals.expected_output: Generates a pre-signed PUT URL from S3/GCS, returns it to the client, creates a pending file_uploads DB record, and requires a separate confirm endpoint — file bytes never touch the backend.
assertions: Generates pre-signed PUT URL from object storage SDK (S3, GCS, Azure Blob)
Returns uploadUrl and fileKey to client — no file bytes in request body
Creates file_uploads DB record with status: 'pending' before returning URL
Provides a separate POST /files/confirm endpoint for upload acknowledgment
Pre-signed URL has expiry TTL (15 minutes or less)

evals.name: Magic Byte Validation Preventing Extension Spoofing
evals.prompt: Add file type validation that cannot be bypassed by renaming a malicious file with a safe extension.
evals.expected_output: Reads the first N bytes of the file and compares against known magic byte signatures, rejects EXE files (MZ header 4D 5A) regardless of extension, and returns 422 on mismatch.
assertions: Reads first bytes of file content to determine actual file type
Validates file type against magic byte signatures, not extension or Content-Type header
Rejects files with EXE magic bytes (4D 5A MZ header) regardless of declared extension
Returns HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity on magic byte mismatch

evals.name: Time-Limited Signed CDN URLs for Private Files
evals.prompt: Implement a file access endpoint for private user documents that prevents auth bypass via raw S3 URLs.
evals.expected_output: Generates a time-limited signed CDN URL per request, blocks access until virus_scan_status is 'clean', and never returns the raw S3 object URL.
assertions: Generates a new signed URL per request — never returns raw S3/GCS object URL
Signed URL expires within 1 hour for view access or 24 hours for download
Blocks file access if virus_scan_status is not 'clean'
Returns 'file is processing' status when scan is still pending
